spacing_and_layout.general: Use generous spacing. Containers must pad content to avoid border collision.
spacing_and_layout.grid: Bento Grid (Control Room Mode) for AI analysis results. Use dense packing for stats, 1px solid borders for definition instead of shadows.
spacing_and_layout.borderRadius: Rounded-none or very subtle rounded-sm (4px) to maintain the tactical, athletic feel.

surfaces.cards: Flat background (#121214), 1px subtle border (#27272A), no shadow. Tactical Minimalism.
surfaces.buttons: Sharp edges, solid primary color (#00E5FF) with black text for main CTAs. Or transparent with 1px border for secondary.
surfaces.modals_overlays: Solid dark background (#0A0A0A) with a sharp border. Avoid glassmorphism as it reduces contrast for performance stats.

motion_and_interactions.buttons: Slight scale down (0.95) on press. Immediate feedback.
motion_and_interactions.loading: Use The 'Tracing Beam' concept - glowing cyan gradient traveling around the video preview edge during AI analysis.
motion_and_interactions.transitions: Fast, crisp transitions. No slow fades.

components.video_player: Edge-to-edge, immersive. Controls overlay with bg-black/40 gradient. Use text-shadow for readability.
components.ai_score_badge: Large condensed font, high contrast. Use Neon Green if score > 80, Blaze Orange if < 50.
components.mistake_list: Left-aligned, 1px left border in Blaze Orange to denote correction needed. Dense layout.
components.nav_bar: Bottom tab nav with crisp icons. Active state highlighted by a Volt Blue top border (2px).

hero_background.description: Cinematic dark abstract background with glowing neon cyan wave outlines
hero_background.placement: Login Screen / Splash Screen background overlay

sample_video_thumbnail_1.description: A man riding a wave on top of a surfboard

sample_video_thumbnail_2.description: Surfer skillfully rides a large wave under a clear sky on the ocean

dark_texture.description: Blue body of water during daytime (darkened for texture)

testing.attributes: All interactive elements MUST include a data-testid attribute. Examples: data-testid='login-google-btn', data-testid='upload-video-btn', data-testid='start-analysis-btn'.

instructions_to_main_agent: Translate Tailwind scale classes into React Native StyleSheet objects or use NativeWind.
Enforce the Dark Theme strictly. The app background is #0A0A0A.
Do NOT use typical blue gradients. Use the Electric Cyan (#00E5FF) solely as an accent/action color on dark backgrounds.
Implement the AI Loading state using a glowing border or an energetic loader.
For the Video Preview, use an edge-to-edge layout without borders.
Never use generic placeholder images. Map the provided image_urls to the corresponding components.
Use Phosphor icons (if possible) or React Native vector icons for a sharp, technical look.
